hookSay: This Thanksgiving month, Swecha is saying thank you, to everyone who keeps our free medical camps going.

beats.label: To our doctors
beats.say: Thank you to the more than {60|sixty} doctors who care for our patients, across up to {12|twelve} specialities.

beats.label: To our volunteers
beats.sub: registration · pharmacy · food and water, at every camp
beats.say: Thank you to the more than {200|two hundred} volunteers at every camp: at registration, in the pharmacy, and serving food and water.

beats.label: To our community
beats.sub: from 183 areas, who trust us with their care
beats.say: And thank you to the more than {11,000|eleven thousand} patients, from {183|one hundred and eighty-three} areas, who trust us with their care.

beats.label: Together, so far
beats.say: Together, we have run {54|fifty-four} camps: more than {39,000|thirty-nine thousand} consultations, {810|eight hundred and ten} free spectacles, and {34|thirty-four} cataract surgeries.

beats.label: This season of giving
beats.sub: Help keep the next camp free
beats.say: This season of giving, say thank you in the most caring way. Help keep the next camp free.

outro: Donate at the link on screen. From all of us at Swecha, thank you.

end.title: Thank you!
lines: Free camps, first Sunday of every month
end.small: Swecha Foundation · Figures from Swecha's 2026 programme proposal (through the 54th camp)
